The class only gets who organic reaches

Your last 7 reels reached between 617 and 7,189 people each. That's the ceiling on who hears about the masterclass, and it moves with how much you post.

No buyer signal

The masterclass does its job. What's missing is a first purchase that pays for ads and shows you who is ready for 1-2-1.

Questions

Before you start

Is this medical advice?

No. The Sparkle Reset is educational. It explains how hormones, food and lifestyle connect so you can make informed choices. For any symptoms or health concerns, please speak to your GP.

Is it a diet?

No. There's no calorie counting and no strict rules. It's about everyday food and habits you enjoy.

Which life stage is it for?

Every one. Day 1 covers how hormones change from your cycle through perimenopause and menopause, so you can apply the week to where you are.

How much time does it take?

One short video and one small action a day, for seven days. Go at your own pace, and keep access.

What happens after the 7 days?

If you want to keep going, the 30-Day Sparkle Programme goes deeper, and you can apply for 1-2-1 coaching with me.
